scope: Living source triage for added records AP-0081 through AP-0170. Sources can support several distinct events; regional summaries overlap individual cases, and 2020 airstrike data are not all individually extracted. Reviewed/partial status records how far a source was assessed for this archive, not proof of a report's truth. Older AP-0001 through AP-0080 still require systematic re-audit.

excluded_or_pending.reason: German investigators reported no religious or political motivation for the 2026 Leimen construction fire. It is not currently classified as anti-Assyrian persecution.

Re-examined report concerns the 22 June 2025 Greek Orthodox Mar Elias Church bombing in Damascus, NOT a December 2024 Syriac Orthodox church attack in Qamishli. The previous research-lead description conflated different events. No Assyrian-specific connection is established, so it is not added to this archive.

Three 2009 Mosul/Kirkuk incident summaries did not identify Assyrian victims or an Assyrian-linked congregation. Their contexts inform regional history, but they are not individually indexed as Assyrian incidents without corroboration.

An Assyrian Policy Institute report tabulates approximately 52 dated 2020 military strike reports near Assyrian settlements. Current AP-0060 is a regional overview. Individual dates and exact locality disclosure require a verified reading of the appendix before event-level indexing, without implying each report corresponds to one missile or an Assyrian casualty.
